description: Source code for managing Linux network namespaces, including creation, deletion, and retrieval of namespace handles, as well as container-specific namespace handling.

methods.name: Setns
methods.description: Sets the network namespace using a handle and namespace type.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the current network namespace to the one represented by NsHandle.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new network namespace, sets it as current, and returns a handle.

methods.name: NewNamed
methods.description: Creates a new named network namespace, sets it as current, and returns a handle.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Gets a handle to the current thread's network namespace.

methods.name: GetFromPath
methods.description: Gets a handle to a network namespace by path.

methods.name: GetFromName
methods.description: Gets a handle to a named network namespace.

methods.name: GetFromPid
methods.description: Gets a handle to the network namespace of a specific process ID.

methods.name: GetFromThread
methods.description: Gets a handle to the network namespace of a specific thread.

methods.name: GetFromDocker
methods.description: Gets a handle to the network namespace of a Docker container by ID.

methods.name: findCgroupMountpoint
methods.description: Finds the cgroup mount point for a given cgroup type.

methods.name: getDockerCgroup
methods.description: Retrieves the cgroup path for a Docker container based on its PID.

methods.name: getPidForContainer
methods.description: Finds the first PID of a container matching a given ID.
